title: Positioning Challenge reference solution
explanation: The card forms the containing block for the badge. Logical inset properties adapt to writing direction; check clipping and stacking if the badge overlaps neighboring content.
manual_validation_checklist: Paste the CSS into the stylesheet used by the starter HTML.

Confirm the required CSS evidence is present; string checks alone do not prove rendered correctness.
